narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Zero is not an even digit, so eight thousand five hundred and sixty is not divisible by two.
<bookmark mark='pair'/>Pair up the kites of a number ending in zero, and none are left without a partner.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Zero left over means everything pairs, so zero counts as even.
